phaseRuns.summary: Initialized ralphi for wibwob-dos. Created .ralphi/config.yaml with project metadata (TypeScript/Bun/blessed TUI), quality commands (test, typecheck, lint, health), 8 rules (Bun-first, strict TS, ES modules, no circular deps, branch policy, etc.), and boundaries. Appended ralphi check to existing .githooks/pre-commit hook. Updated .gitignore to track config but ignore runtime state. Kept existing AGENTS.md as-is per user preference.

Generated a full PRD for E055 — TUI AppleScript Control. 14 user stories across 3 layers: runtime (registerClickable → coords in describeState, SDK helpers auto-register, overlay button positions), API/CLI (menu.close, menu/list open state, menu.activate), and scripts (wait-for.sh fix, sleep elimination, test isolation fix, scoped click-text, error hints). Key design decisions captured via ralphi_ask_user_question: F01 before F02, SDK helpers auto-register, menu.activate thin+visual, Test 13 fix via test isolation. Success metric: 15/15 autoresearch benchmark stable.
